Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: The party card always shows the full member list now - the collapsed icon strip and its chevron are gone. Joining someone else's Party Finder shows what the party is recruiting for, even across worlds, instead of just "in a party". Opening a player's profile re-reads their rating, so votes cast by other people show up without a reload. Progress updates now go through a shared queue: press Update and it says Queued until the result arrives, and a player who has been looked up once is checked again later rather than never.
